en.hubeali: And it is reported by Nadir the servant who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassanasws placed one Jowzinja (a sweet) upon the other, and gave it to me’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from Nadir al-Khadim who has said the following “
Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would place Jawzinajah (a type of sweet) one on top of the other, and then give them to me.’”
